problem_type: valid raster asset rejected before video generation
symptom: A Codex-generated PNG was reported as HTML/XML/SVG text and rejected before AutoDL.art H3 submission even though its PNG signature and dimensions were valid.
direct_cause: The local asset guard decoded the first 2048 bytes of every non-SVG image as UTF-8 and rejected any occurrence of an SVG tag, including an SVG icon embedded inside the PNG's C2PA metadata.
class_root: The shared media boundary did not make magic-byte classification authoritative before applying text-payload heuristics, so valid binary raster containers could be reclassified from incidental metadata bytes.
affected_population: Users sending Codex-generated PNGs with C2PA metadata into any image-reference generation path
Users sending any recognized raster image whose early metadata contains HTML, XML, or SVG-like text
All providers and upload strategies that consume local images through assertLocalAssetTransportReady or localizeAssetsForVendor
entry_points: localizeAssetsForVendor before local image upload or inline transport
custom provider dispatch and standard runtime provider dispatch through the shared local asset reader
internal_only_reason: The failure is caused entirely by Nomi's ordering of its own byte-sniffing and markup heuristics. The PNG signature, embedded metadata bytes, and rejection branch are locally observable; no provider API, model behavior, or third-party dependency contract is changed or needed to decide the invariant.
invariants: A recognized raster magic header is authoritative for binary-vs-text classification; incidental markup strings inside that binary container cannot reclassify it as a text payload.
A recognized raster whose declared known image type conflicts with its magic header is rejected before upload.
Only content without a recognized binary media header is eligible for the bounded HTML/XML/SVG text-payload heuristic, while declared SVG continues through strict XML and namespace validation.

recurrence.reason: The same false rejection recurs for every recognized raster whose early EXIF, C2PA, or other binary metadata contains markup-like text, independent of provider or model.
same_class_scan: Searched every production call to assertLocalAssetMediaBytes, assertLocalAssetTransportReady, and localizeAssetsForVendor and confirmed standard runtime and custom-call generation share this boundary.
Compared every raster magic type in electron/assets/mediaTypes.ts with the declared raster set enforced by assetLocalization and kept format-mismatch rejection intact.
Exercised both the reported PNG/C2PA SVG shape and the equivalent JPEG/EXIF HTML-text shape while retaining negative coverage for markup disguised as PNG, corrupt rasters, and malformed SVG.

prevention.strategy: Make recognized binary magic authoritative at the earliest shared local-asset boundary and run text-payload heuristics only when no binary media header is recognized.

migration: No persisted-data migration is required. Existing project assets remain byte-for-byte unchanged and become usable on their next preflight; no fallback or provider-specific exception is introduced.
residual_risks: Magic-byte detection validates the registered container signature rather than fully decoding every raster; downstream decoders and providers remain responsible for detecting later structural corruption.
Unrecognized future raster formats still fail closed until added to the global media type registry.
